name: Ember Kin
introduction: The Ember Kin carry a small fire through a changed world. Protect the hearth, find the next meal, and keep the path open.
neutralHello: Share the fire, and we can share the road.
tradeRequest: We can trade what we gathered before the next storm.
declaringWar: Your raiders have crossed our marked ground.
attacked: The hearth stands. Our scouts are already moving.
defeated: The last ember fades, but the trail remains.
